tasks.description: Run Review Agent over the full P0/P1/P2 implementation; repair findings in place and rerun verification.
tests_run: pnpm dev source index --json >/tmp/cmap-source-index.json && pnpm dev benchmark source-intelligence --file bench/source-intelligence.jsonl --min-f1 80

findings.summary: Review HTML source freshness used index metadata only and could show stale source index as fresh.
findings.fix_evidence: collectSourceEvidence now calls currentSourceFileStates(cwd, index); source-intelligence-brief-view test mutates src/a.ts after indexing and asserts embedded sourceEvidence freshness is stale.
Discovery now loads .gitignore and .codexignore and records ignoreFiles in metadata; source-intelligence.test asserts private/agent-hidden.ts is excluded and ignoreFiles lists both files.

findings.summary: impact likelyTests unconditionally added every Test symbol file, causing false positives and benchmark precision loss.
findings.fix_evidence: Removed unconditional Test symbol loop; source-intelligence and P2 impact tests assert unrelated.test.ts is not included; repo benchmark source-intelligence --min-f1 80 passes with 100% F1.

findings.summary: symbol callers/callees returned omitted counts but no truncated metadata.
findings.fix_evidence: runSymbolEdges now returns/records truncated and Markdown prints Truncated; symbol integration test asserts callers truncated true and callees truncated false.

findings.summary: source architecture candidate option defaulted on and report lacked omitted/confidence summary.
findings.fix_evidence: architectureCandidateHints now require includeCandidates; report includes omitted and confidence; P2 test asserts default hints are empty while candidateHints remain advisory and --include-candidates emits candidate-only hints.

evidence.implementation_notes: Review findings P2-F001..P2-F005 fixed in place; no rewrite/revert performed.
